source.source_locator: 教則 第5章 5.2.2(2)「自動操縦におけるヒューマンエラーの傾向」（教則表示ページ60 / PDF viewer 66）

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 自動操縦の設定経路は、障害物等を事前に現地確認する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 地図上でwaypointを設定すれば現地障害物確認は不要。
evidence.reasoning_path: waypoint planning -> map omission risk -> onsite route obstacle verification

collision.note: LOW。Q086は自動操縦の再現性メリット、Q017はGNSS精度による経路誤差であり、設定時の現地障害物確認は未出。

independent_review.rationale: 5.2.2 explicitly requires onsite preconfirmation of obstacles along an automatically configured waypoint route to mitigate setup-related collision/crash. Existing auto-flight questions test repeatability and GNSS route error, not this preflight human-error control.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent with the current MLIT 第5版 Chapter 5, preserves second-class scope, and correctly isolates one semantic duplicate. The other 19 candidates test distinct operational process, insurance/security, GNSS-off control, aircraft-specific takeoff/landing technique, human-error mitigation, CRM-skill, and assistant-role propositions with useful practice value. Near-neighbor candidates C004, C012, C014 and C020 remain distinct from the cited canonical questions because they require different causal or operational decision boundaries.
